_doc: World-watch state for the role-org MVP. See docs/architecture/ROLE_ORG_DESIGN.md. Updated by the /world-watch skill; the SessionStart hook only reads lastScan to decide if a scan is due. Cadence days: weekly=7, monthly=30, quarterly=90.

watch_signals: New/updated CVE or GitHub Advisory affecting a pinned dependency (freerasp, http_certificate_pinning, firebase_app_check, dio, http, crypto, flutter_onnxruntime, whisper_ggml_plus, record) or any transitive Firebase/Dart pub package
freeRASP (Talsec) release: changes to root/jailbreak/Frida/hook/tamper detection thresholds, new attack-class coverage, or breaking callback API changes requiring re-review (cf. BUT-1218)
Firebase/GCP security bulletin or advisory touching Auth, App Check, Firestore/RTDB rules, Storage, or Cloud Functions (e.g. CVE-2025-0838-class fixes forcing a firebase_core bump)
New OWASP MASVS/MASTG/MASWE control, version bump, or test case that changes our mobile baseline (cert pinning, secure storage, anti-tampering, on-device-model integrity)
New mobile attack class or technique (Frida/Magisk bypass, emulator/bot evasion, instrumentation, model-extraction against on-device ONNX/CRF, TLS pin bypass) that defeats a current control
App Store Review Guideline or Google Play policy change with a security/privacy/data-sharing or target-API/permission deadline that gates a release

whisper.cpp (ggml-org) release/advisory: memory-safety fixes in GGML/model parsing or WAV decoding — native FFI attack surface for the on-device KB-Whisper voice feature (added 2026-07-12, kb-whisper plan)

Apple Developer Program License Agreement (DPLA) updates that must be accepted before the next release

Google Play Data Safety form requirement changes — new data types, disclosure rules, or consistency-with-privacy-policy enforcement
Age-rating system changes (Apple's new age-rating tiers / questionnaire; Google Play / IARC content-rating updates) affecting the app's declared rating
Privacy-manifest / SDK privacy requirements for bundled third-party SDKs (Firebase, analytics, ONNX runtime deps) that must each ship their own manifest
App-store-driven privacy/consent UX norms (privacy nutrition labels, tracking-consent prompts, account-deletion entry points) — drifting expectations reviewers now enforce
Regional distribution rule changes (EU DMA / alternative distribution, Brazil, developer-verification mandates) that alter what must ship per market
